+    Type: String
+    Description: Name for the stack
+

+        Version: '2012-10-17'
+        Statement:
+          - Effect: Allow
+            Principal:
+              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
+            Action: sts:AssumeRole
+      ManagedPolicyArns:
+        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole

+                  - ssm:PutParameter

+                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${DecisionModeSsmParam}'
+                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:ssm:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:parameter${MemoryIdSsmParam}'
+        - PolicyName: DynamoDBReadAccess
+          PolicyDocument:
+            Version: '2012-10-17'
+            Statement:
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - dynamodb:Scan

+                  - !Sub 'arn:aws:dynamodb:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:table/${SessionTableName}'
+        - PolicyName: AgentCoreMemoryAccess
+          PolicyDocument:
+            Version: '2012-10-17'
+            Statement:
+              - Effect: Allow
+                Action:
+                  - bedrock-agentcore:ListEvents
+                  - bedrock-agentcore:ListMemoryRecords
+                  - bedrock-agentcore:RetrieveMemoryRecords
+                  - bedrock-agentcore:GetMemory
+                Resource: '*'
+
+  # Lambda Functions

+      FunctionName: !Sub '${StackName}-get-mode'

+      Handler: get_mode.handler
+      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
+      Code: lambdas/get_mode/
+      Environment:
+        Variables:
+          DECISION_MODE_SSM_PARAM: !Ref DecisionModeSsmParam
+      Timeout: 10
+
+  SetModeFunction:
+    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
+    Properties:
+      FunctionName: !Sub '${StackName}-set-mode'
+      Runtime: python3.11
+      Handler: set_mode.handler
+      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
+      Code: lambdas/set_mode/
+      Environment:
+        Variables:
+          DECISION_MODE_SSM_PARAM: !Ref DecisionModeSsmParam
+      Timeout: 10
+
+  GetSessionsFunction:
+    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
+    Properties:
+      FunctionName: !Sub '${StackName}-get-sessions'
+      Runtime: python3.11
+      Handler: get_sessions.handler
+      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
+      Code: lambdas/get_sessions/
+      Environment:
+        Variables:
+          TABLE_NAME: !Ref SessionTableName
+      Timeout: 30
+
+  GetMemoryFunction:
+    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
+    Properties:
+      FunctionName: !Sub '${StackName}-get-memory'
+      Runtime: python3.11
+      Handler: get_memory.handler
+      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
+      Code: lambdas/get_memory/
+      Environment:
+        Variables:
+          MEMORY_ID_SSM_PARAM: !Ref MemoryIdSsmParam
+          DECISION_MODE_SSM_PARAM: !Ref DecisionModeSsmParam
+      Timeout: 30
+
+  SearchMemoryFunction:
+    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
+    Properties:
+      FunctionName: !Sub '${StackName}-search-memory'
+      Runtime: python3.11
+      Handler: search_memory.handler
+      Role: !GetAtt LambdaExecutionRole.Arn
+      Code: lambdas/search_memory/
+      Environment:
+        Variables:
+          MEMORY_ID_SSM_PARAM: !Ref MemoryIdSsmParam
+      Timeout: 30
+
+  # API Gateway
+  RestApi:
+    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::RestApi
+    Properties:
+      Name: !Sub '${StackName}-api'
+      Description: Admin API for Insurance Claims Demo
+
+  # Cognito Authorizer
+  ApiAuthorizer:
+    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Authorizer
+    Properties:
+      Name: CognitoAdminAuthorizer

+      IdentitySource: method.request.header.Authorization
+      RestApiId: !Ref RestApi
+      ProviderARNs:
+        - Fn::ImportValue: !Sub '${CognitoStackName}-pool-arn'
+
+  # Resources: /admin
+  AdminResource:
+    Type: AWS::ApiGateway::Resource

discussion_comments.comment_body: Every admin route uses a Cognito user-pool authorizer but none checks membership in the admin group, so any authenticated user can read another policyholder’s memory, enumerate sessions, search memory, or change the global decision mode. Checking requestContext.authorizer.claims['cognito:groups'] inside each of the five Lambda handlers would work, but it enforces authorization after the request has already reached business logic, and the check has to be correctly repeated in every handler. AWS’s documented pattern for this (“Using groups to control permission with Amazon API Gateway”) is to enforce group membership at the gateway layer, ahead of the handlers: add a custom Lambda authorizer (or Amazon Verified Permissions) in front of the existing Cognito authorizer that reads cognito:groups and denies the invoke before any of the five admin Lambdas run. The admin group already exists in setup/cognito.yaml.

Can you address CKV2_GHA_1: Top-level permissions should be scoped?  
Add `permissions: read-all` at the workflow level and override per-job where write is needed.

Will need to add a `permissions: { contents: read, id-token: write }` on the `e2e` job.

Done in 155b3a2. Added `permissions: read-all` at the workflow level and scoped each job to least-privilege:

- `unit`: `contents: read` (checkout only)
- `e2e`: `contents: read` + `id-token: write` (required for the OIDC role assumption via `aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials`)

Verified locally with checkov 3.3.6: `CKV2_GHA_1` goes from FAILED to **PASSED**, and no new finding is introduced. I also audited every step that consumes a `GITHUB_TOKEN` scope to confirm none lost a permission it relies on (`make e2e` runs on the assumed AWS role, not the GitHub token).

One transparency note: checkov also reports a pre-existing `CKV_GHA_7` on this file ("workflow_dispatch inputs must be empty"), triggered by the `run_e2e` toggle that lets a maintainer launch the live deploy→assert→destroy e2e on demand. It predates this change and the repo's ASH scan treats it as advisory (`continue-on-error: true`). Happy to drop the input if you'd prefer a clean checkov pass — that just means the e2e would run on `main` only, losing the manual trigger. Let me know your preference.
I'm ok with the CKV_GHA_7 if it doesn't block merging.
